title: Chats and drafts don't always sync to the Grok app
short_title: Chats and drafts don't always sync to Grok
summary: Two users on X reported that, using Grok Bots inside the Grok app, chats don't always sync: drafts the bot says are in the chat show up on one device or app but not the other. Second report: https://x.com/i/status/2111295921539699143

title: Plugins page lists fewer Finance accounts than are connected
short_title: Plugins page undercounts connected Finance accounts
summary: A user on X reported that Grok Bot's Your plugins page shows only one of two connected Plaid finance institutions, while Grok's Connectors shows both. They said Grok Bot itself still works; only the page is wrong.

title: Convex plugin stuck on an old version
summary: A user replying to the plugin submission post said the Convex plugin is still pinned to version 1.0.0, which ships always-on rules that take about 30k tokens of context, even though the plugin's own project fixed that. A team member acknowledged the report.

title: Locked out during plan unification
summary: A user on X reported being locked out of Grok Bot for about two days while moving to the unified plan. A team member replied that they are looking into it.

title: 404 errors on unified plan link
summary: Users replying to the unified plan announcement got 404 errors from a shared link. A team member said the cause was mitigated.
